common.tagline: That is not dead which can eternal lie

metadata.description: Session scheduling for tabletop Call of Cthulhu campaigns

forbidden.title: Not yours to open
forbidden.description: This part is kept by somebody else. If you think that is wrong, ask whoever runs it.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.description: That page does not exist, or it is not one of yours.

unauthorized.title: You have been signed out
unauthorized.description: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: The page could not be loaded. Trying again often works.

errors.unauthorized: You need to sign in to continue.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: That page or record does not exist.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Accounts are created by an administrator. If you do not have one, ask them for an activation link.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errors.failed: Could not set your password. Check the requirements and try again.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Activation links are valid for a limited time. Ask your administrator to issue a new one.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.description: The account is set up. Sign in with the password you chose.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.description: Check that you copied the whole address. If it still fails, ask your administrator for a new link.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the address your account uses and we will send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.submitted: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It expires in an hour and can be used once.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password. Every other signed-in session will be ended.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.failed: Could not set your password. Try a longer passphrase.

errors.passwordTooCommon: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer phrase.
errors.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask an administrator for a new one.
errors.accountAlreadyActive: This account has already been activated.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account with that address already exists.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pageDescription: Your details, and how you hear from us.
settings.name: Name
settings.nameHint: How you appear to the rest of your campaigns.
settings.timezoneHint: An IANA name such as Europe/Warsaw. Sessions always show the campaign’s zone; this one is for your own reminders.
settings.emailHint: Invitations, availability requests and confirmed dates. Sent to {email}.
settings.inAppHint: Everything is kept here whether or not it is emailed.
settings.passwordChanged: Changed. Every other signed-in device has been signed out.

errors.invalidTimezone: That is not a time zone this application recognises.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.passwordCommon: That password appears on lists of the most common ones. Choose another.
errors.currentPassword: Your current password is not right.

sessionOverview.emptyDescription: Sessions from your campaigns will appear here.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Counts only - no campaign is named here.

reports.title: Problem reports
reports.description: Defects and suggestions submitted from inside the application.

users.title: Users
users.description: Created here, activated by their owner through a link.

createUser.title: New user
createUser.description: Creates the account and issues an activation link.
createUser.createdDescription: Send this activation link to its owner. It will not be shown again.
createUser.name: Name
createUser.emailHint: Used to sign in and to reset the password.
createUser.roleHint: Administrators manage accounts. Campaign roles are separate and set per campaign.

userActions.newLinkDescription: The previous link for {name} no longer works. This one will not be shown again.
userActions.eraseDescription: Their row and everything addressed to them is destroyed: memberships, availability, notifications. This cannot be undone.
userActions.closeDescription: They are signed out, cannot sign in again, and leave every campaign. What they did — availability, attendance, sessions played — is kept.
userActions.eraseHint: Removes the row itself. Available because this account authored nothing anybody else depends on.
userActions.eraseBlocked: Not possible: {blockers}. Those belong to other people’s history.
userActions.disableDescription: They will be signed out immediately and cannot sign in again until the account is enabled. Their campaigns and past sessions are untouched.

blockers.campaigns: owns {count, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}
blockers.sessions: created {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}
blockers.invitations: issued {count, plural, one {# invitation} other {# invitations}}
blockers.scenarios: wrote {count, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}}
blockers.activationLinks: issued {count, plural, one {# activation link} other {# activation links}}

errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot remove your own account.
errors.ownsCampaigns: They own a campaign. Transfer it first, or close the account instead.
errors.createdSessions: They created a session somebody else may be waiting on. Close the account instead.
errors.createdInvitations: They issued an invitation that is still on record. Close the account instead.
errors.createdScenarios: They wrote a scenario a campaign still refers to. Close the account instead.
errors.issuedActivationLinks: They issued an activation link for somebody else. Close the account instead.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. The archive is empty.

list.title: Campaigns
list.emptyDescription: Create a campaign, or wait for a Keeper to invite you.

create.title: New campaign
create.description: You will be its Keeper and its owner.
create.name: Name
create.scenarioHint: Optional. You can add or change this later.

errors.invalidTimezone: That is not a recognised time zone.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.emptyKeeper: Create a session and ask the party when they are free.
sessions.emptyInvestigator: The Keeper has not planned anything yet.

errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the Keeper for a new one.
errors.exhausted: This invitation has already been used up.
errors.notForYou: This invitation was issued for somebody else.
errors.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.

leave.title: Leave this campaign?
leave.description: You lose access until somebody invites you back. Your past availability and attendance are kept.

memberActions.removeDescription: They lose access to this campaign. Their past availability and attendance are kept, and they can be invited back.

invitePage.alreadyMemberDescription: Nothing to accept - the campaign is already on your list.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Invitations last two weeks. Ask the Keeper to send a fresh link.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.description: The Keeper revoked this link. Ask them for a new one if that was a mistake.

exhausted.title: This invitation has been used up
exhausted.description: The link reached the number of people it was issued for.

notForYou.title: This invitation is for somebody else
notForYou.description: It was issued for one specific person and cannot be used by anyone else, even if it was forwarded to you.

invalid.title: This invitation is not valid
invalid.description: Check that you copied the whole address, then ask the Keeper for a new link.

inviteDialog.title: Invite to the campaign
inviteDialog.description: Invitations work for people who already have an account here.
inviteDialog.readyDescription: Send this link to whoever should join. It will not be shown again.
inviteDialog.noCandidates: Everyone with an account is already in this campaign.
inviteDialog.personalHint: Only they can use the link, even if it is forwarded.
inviteDialog.maxUsesHint: The link stops working once this many people have joined.

errors.alreadyMember: They are already in this campaign.
errors.archived: This campaign is archived and cannot be changed.
errors.personalSingleUse: A personal invitation can only be used once.

settings.title: Settings
settings.archivedNotice: This campaign is archived and read-only. Change its status to something else and save to bring it back.
settings.name: Name
settings.timezoneHint: An IANA identifier such as Europe/Warsaw. The availability grid is drawn in this zone for every member, so that everyone is looking at the same hours.
settings.transferHint: They become the owner and a Keeper. You stay a Keeper and can then leave if you want to.
settings.noTransferCandidates: Invite somebody else before you can hand the campaign over.
settings.archiveHint: Hides the campaign and makes it read-only. Sessions and availability are kept.
settings.transferConfirmDescription: They become the owner and can archive it, manage membership and change roles — including yours. You cannot take it back yourself.
settings.archiveConfirmDescription: It disappears from everyone's list and becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted.

errors.invalidTimezone: That is not a recognised time zone.
errors.campaignArchived: This campaign is archived and cannot be changed.
errors.newOwnerMustBeMember: The new owner has to be an active member.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the campaign owner can do that.

create.title: New session
create.description: Starts as a draft. Nobody is asked anything until you open it.

definition.title: Title
definition.hoursHint: A session runs from its start to the end of the offered hours unless somebody’s availability cuts it short. The minimum is the shortest run worth gathering for.
definition.deadlineHint: Optional. Answering closes when this day ends in {timezone}, and the dates are worked out on their own.
definition.quorumHint: How many players have to be free. The Keeper is not counted — they have to be there regardless.
definition.answersAtRisk: {count, plural, one {One person has} other {# people have}} already answered. Changing the dates or the hours clears every answer; changing anything else leaves them alone.

errors.windowEndsBeforeStart: The window ends before it begins.
errors.windowTooWide: That search window is too wide. Ninety days is the maximum.
errors.gridEndsBeforeStart: The evening ends before it starts.
errors.gridTooShort: Those hours cannot contain a session of that minimum length.
errors.definitionLocked: This session has moved on and its dates can no longer be changed.
errors.deadlineAfterStart: The deadline falls after the first date being searched.
errors.quorumTooLow: A quorum has to be at least one.
errors.quorumTooHigh: That is more players than are invited, so no date could ever meet it.
errors.campaignArchived: This campaign is archived and cannot be changed.

participants.name: Name
participants.quorumHint: How many of the invited have to be free for the session to happen. Half plus one — {count} for this group — keeps a single busy person from holding up the campaign.

errors.participantsLocked: The roster is fixed once a date has been proposed. Reopen availability to change it.
errors.noKeeper: Somebody has to run the session.
errors.quorumTooHigh: The quorum is higher than the number of people invited, so no date could ever work.

nextCard.nothingPlanned: Nothing planned and nothing being arranged. This is the state campaigns quietly end in.
nextCard.keeperOnly: Only a Keeper can start one. A nudge usually does it.

list.title: Sessions
list.description: Upcoming plans and recent sessions across your campaigns.

participantsPage.title: Participants
participantsPage.attendanceDescription: Record attendance and close the session. This cannot be undone.
participantsPage.closed: This session is closed. Its roster is on the overview.

overview.answered: You have said when you are free.
overview.notAnswered: You have not said when you are free yet.

manual.title: Set the date by hand
manual.description: Everyone invited is told. Times are in {timezone}.
manual.warning: Setting a date by hand overrides what people said they could do.

reopenDialog.title: Ask everyone again?
reopenDialog.description: Every answer already given is cleared, and any confirmed date is dropped.
reopenDialog.deadlineHint: Optional. Answering closes when this day ends in {timezone}; without one it stays open until you close it.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this session?
cancelDialog.description: Everyone invited is told, with the reason. This cannot be undone.

closeDialog.title: Stop asking for availability?
closeDialog.description: Nobody can change their answer afterwards, and the dates already suggested stay as they are. You can reopen it later if plans change.

completeDialog.title: Mark this session as played?
completeDialog.description: Record who was there on the participants tab first if you have not already. A played session cannot be reopened.

errors.noKeeper: Nobody is set to run this session.
errors.fewerThanQuorum: Fewer people are invited than the quorum requires, so no date could ever work.
errors.deadlineAfterStart: The deadline falls after the first date being searched.
errors.sessionMovedOn: Somebody else changed this session. Reload and try again.
errors.invalidTransition: That is not possible from the session’s current state.
errors.endBeforeStart: The session ends before it starts.
errors.publishFailed: Could not open this session for availability.

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Describe a defect, confusing behaviour, or an improvement that would help.
report.receivedDescription: It is now in the administrator’s queue.
report.saved: The report was saved. Email delivery will happen in the background.
report.placeholder: What did you try, what happened, and what did you expect?
report.hint: The current page is attached automatically. Do not include passwords or private campaign material.

errors.failed: The report could not be saved.

list.emptyDescription: Problem reports and product suggestions will appear here.

errors.messageTooShort: Add a little more detail so the report can be understood.
errors.messageTooLong: The report is too long. Keep it below 4,000 characters.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent several reports recently. Try again later.

availabilityRequested.subject: When are you free for {session}?
availabilityRequested.body: {campaign} is looking for a date for {session}.
availabilityRequested.channel: {campaign} is looking for a date for {session}.

availabilityReminder.subject: Still waiting on you for {session}
availabilityReminder.body: You have not said when you are free for {session}.
availabilityReminder.channel: Some answers are still missing for {session}.

collectionClosed.subject: Answers are in for {session}
collectionClosed.body: The deadline for {session} has passed and the possible dates have been worked out. Pick one when you have a moment.
collectionClosed.channel: Answers are in for {session}; the Keeper is choosing a date.

rescheduled.subject: {session} has moved{suffix}
rescheduled.body: {session} has been moved. It will now run {when}.

noNext.subject: {campaign} has no next session
noNext.body: Nothing is scheduled in {campaign}. Campaigns end this way more often than they end badly.

issue.subject: New issue report from {actor}
issue.channel: A new issue report was submitted.

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Paste a channel webhook to tell the group in Discord as well as by email.
discord.configuredDescription: Posts when a session is announced, confirmed, moved or cancelled.
discord.webhookHint: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy webhook URL.
discord.webhookConfiguredHint: One is already stored. Entering another replaces it; it is never shown again.

removeDialog.title: Stop posting to Discord?
removeDialog.description: Nothing from this campaign will be posted to the channel afterwards. Email and in-app notifications are unaffected.

errors.invalid: That is not a Discord webhook address. Copy it from the channel’s integration settings.
errors.missing: There is nothing to test yet.
errors.rejected: Discord refused the message. The webhook may have been deleted.
errors.rateLimited: That has been tested a lot recently. Give it a few minutes.
errors.test: Could not post to that channel.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyDescription: Invitations, availability requests and confirmed dates arrive here.

worker.title: Worker
worker.stale: Not reporting. Nothing is being delivered and no deadline will close until it is back.
worker.never: No heartbeat has ever been recorded.
worker.overdue: {count, plural, one {# session is} other {# sessions are}} past a deadline that has not been closed.

metrics.campaignsDetail: {active} active{idle, plural, =0 {} other {, # with nothing planned}}

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.failure: {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} · {date} UTC

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Every primitive rendered against the real tokens. Development only.

typography.title: Typography
typography.body: Body text in Spectral. The session ran long past midnight, and nobody wished to be the one who said so aloud.
typography.interface: Interface text in Inter — labels, tables and the availability grid.

forms.title: Forms
forms.campaignHint: Shown to every member of the campaign.
forms.invalidMessage: A name must be at least three characters.
forms.descriptionPlaceholder: What the investigators know so far…

availability.title: Availability palette
availability.states: Slot states — colour plus glyph, never colour alone
availability.density: Density ramp — the count is always printed

cards.title: Cards
cards.plain: A plain card on the raised surface.

states.title: States
states.emptyDescription: No campaigns have been recorded yet.

interactive.title: Overlays
interactive.dialogDescription: Availability closes on Thursday at midnight.
interactive.dialogBody: Focus is trapped, the page behind is locked, and Escape dismisses.
interactive.popoverBody: Positioned and dismissed by the primitive.

tabs.responsesBody: Who has answered and who has not.

confirm.title: Cancel this session?
confirm.description: Every participant will be notified. This cannot be undone.

diagnostics.nobodyDescription: No date can be worked out until people say when they are free. None of the {count} invited have answered.
diagnostics.tooShortDescription: Every day in the search offers fewer hours than the session needs, so there was nothing to rank. Widen the hours the grid covers, or shorten the minimum length.
diagnostics.blockedTitle: No date works for everyone who has to be there
diagnostics.allRuledOut: All {count} possible evenings were ruled out.
diagnostics.keeperUnavailable: {count} because a Keeper is not free.
diagnostics.requiredUnavailable: {count} because somebody required is not free.
diagnostics.quorumMissed: {count} because too few players are free: the best any evening reached was {best} of the {quorum} needed.
diagnostics.widerRange: Search a wider range of dates.
diagnostics.makeOptional: Make {name} optional, or ask them to answer again.
diagnostics.shorten: Shorten the minimum length, or start earlier in the day.

panel.title: Dates
panel.summary: {responded} of {total} have answered. Quorum is {quorum}, and a session runs at least {hours} hours.
panel.stale: Somebody has answered since this search ran. Search again to take their answer into account.
panel.emptyDescription: Searching decides nothing — it ranks the evenings that would work.
panel.confirmDescription: {window} in {timezone}. Everyone invited is told, and answers close.

errors.notSearchable: Dates can only be searched while a session is collecting answers or choosing between them.
errors.proposalStale: That suggestion came from an earlier search. Search again and pick from the new list.
errors.sessionMovedOn: Somebody else changed this session. Reload and try again.
errors.invalidTransition: That is not possible from the session’s current state.
errors.rateLimited: That search has run a lot recently. Give it a few minutes.

proposal.notAnswered: {count, plural, one {One person has} other {# people have}} not answered

dayDialog.question: Can you make this evening?
dayDialog.tooShort: That is shorter than the {hours} hours this session needs, so it cannot run on this evening.
dayDialog.hoursHint: Leave these alone unless you start late or have to leave early.

IF_NEED_BE.label: At a push
IF_NEED_BE.help: Only if the date depends on it.

panel.suggestionApplied: Filled in from {title}. Check it before saving.
panel.instructions: Pick an evening to answer it. Pick it again to change how firm that is. Open the clock on an evening you start late or have to leave early.
panel.tooShort: {count, plural, one {One evening is} other {# evenings are}} marked for less than {hours} hours, so this session could not run then. They are outlined below.
panel.privacySummary: {responded} of {total} answered. Who said what stays between each player and the Keeper.

closed.DRAFT: Nobody has been asked yet. The Keeper opens this when the session is ready.
closed.PROPOSED: Answers are closed. The Keeper is choosing between the dates that work.
closed.SCHEDULED: The date is settled, so answers are closed.

weeknights.label: Weeknights
weeknights.description: Free every Monday to Friday evening, from the usual start.

weekends.label: Weekends
weekends.description: Free on Saturdays and Sundays, the whole evening.

noneOfThese.label: None of these
noneOfThese.description: Cannot make any of the dates offered.

errors.deadlinePassed: The deadline has passed, so answers are closed. Ask the Keeper to reopen it.
errors.notInvited: You are not on the list for this session.
errors.notCollecting: This session is not asking for availability at the moment.

windows.empty: No evening yet has enough people free for long enough.
